messages:
mike_ops: Heads up — we just saw the EU allocation drop by 12 units for the May wave. That means queue re-ordering for a handful of customer Dedicated pools. Can vendor give updated ETA + whether replacements are air or ocean?
lee_supply: @vendor-linx any visibility? we pushed payment terms last week, hoping that would keep lead time steady.
vendor-linx: Sorry for the late reply. Carrier pushed a consolidation change. 12 units moved to a later manifest; 4 can air-ship as partial replacement. ETA air = 2024-05-09, ETA consolidated ocean = 2024-05-21.
anna_logistics: OK noted. For the 4 air units — can you confirm AWB + whether they pass RoHS/CE pre-inspection? we need docs for EU customs.
vendor-linx: AWB for the air parcel: `AWB123456789`. Pre-inspection passed on 4/18, report id `QA-4421`. We'll attach scanning info to the portal by EOD.
mike_ops: @lee_supply we should reserve the priority slots for the 4 air units to cover the most latency-sensitive customers. Also need RMA plan for the backlog units — are we getting refurbished swaps or full replacements?
lee_supply: Vendor said refurbished available but they need our sign-off on warranty credit. I asked for a per-unit credit number; waiting.
vendor-linx: Confirming refurbished replacements for the ocean manifest units. Warranty credit proposal: 12% per refurbished unit vs full replacement. If you want full replacements, lead time increases by ~10 days and extra cost applies.
anna_logistics: For RMA logistics: if we accept refurbished, can you provide pre-printed return labels and a consolidated manifest? minimizes back-and-forth at the depot.
vendor-linx: Yes — we'll create consolidated RMA AWB: `RMA-AWB-7788`. Labels will be printed and pushed to your portal. Need confirmation of depot address and contact.
mike_ops: Use EU depot: Redwood Depot FRA-3, contact: Jonas (jonas@redwood.com). Also provide serial mapping — we need inbound serials to allocate nodes.
vendor-linx: Understood. Serial mapping ETA: 4/20 10:00 CET. We'll also include batch-level temperature logs.
ops-bot: Deploy notice: queued reassignments triggered for 4 air units -> will pause auto-scaling policies for affected Dedicated pools at 2024-05-03T14:00Z to avoid churn.
lee_supply: One more ask — pricing. Is the 12% warranty credit fixed or negotiable if we shift payment terms earlier? can we push to 15%?
vendor-linx: We can move to 15% credit if payment is net-15 on the consolidated manifest and you confirm by EOD today. Otherwise 12% stands.
mike_ops: I approve taking the 4 air units and 15% credit if finance signs net-15. @lee_supply please confirm with finance and vendor.
lee_supply: forwarding to finance now. will update in this thread once they respond.
anna_logistics: Once serials arrive, I'll schedule inbound checks and reserve space at FRA-3. Also flagging customs team to expect `AWB123456789` + `RMA-AWB-7788`.
mike_ops: Thanks all — quick action here avoids a bigger slowdown. If vendor can't deliver serial mapping on time we should escalate to the account manager.
vendor-linx: Acknowledged. We'll push serial mapping and label files by 10:00 CET 4/20.
ops-bot: Reminder: attach shipment docs to the vendor portal under ticket `V-8812`.
